content.text:
Here is a comprehensive report of the findings.

---

## Memo CRUD Mutations and Queries -- Frontend Module

### Primary Module Location

The main frontend module containing memo CRUD mutations and queries is:

**`/bench/repo/web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts`**

This is the central file that defines React Query hooks (via `@tanstack/react-query`) wrapping every core memo CRUD operation.

### Service Client

The generated service client used is **`memoServiceClient`**, created in:

**`/bench/repo/web/src/connect.ts`** (line 197)

```typescript
export const memoServiceClient = createClient(MemoService, transport);
```

It is built with `@connectrpc/connect`'s `createClient` function, consuming the generated protobuf service descriptor `MemoService` imported from:

**`/bench/repo/web/src/types/proto/api/v1/memo_service_pb.ts`**

The full service name in the proto definition is `memos.api.v1.MemoService`.

### Queries and Mutations in `useMemoQueries.ts`

| Export | Type | Service RPC Called | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| `useMemos` | query | `memoServiceClient.listMemos` | List memos (single page) |
| `useInfiniteMemos` | infinite query | `memoServiceClient.listMemos` | Paginated infinite-scroll memo listing |
| `useMemo` | query | `memoServiceClient.getMemo` | Get a single memo by name |
| `useLinkMetadata` | query | `memoServiceClient.getLinkMetadata` | Fetch link preview metadata |
| `useCreateMemo` | mutation | `memoServiceClient.createMemo` | Create a new memo |
| `useUpdateMemo` | mutation | `memoServiceClient.updateMemo` | Update an existing memo (with field mask) |
| `useDeleteMemo` | mutation | `memoServiceClient.deleteMemo` | Delete a memo |
| `useMemoComments` | query | `memoServiceClient.listMemoComments` | List comments on a memo (single page) |
| `useInfiniteMemoComments` | infinite query | `memoServiceClient.listMemoComments` | Paginated comments listing |

### Additional Memo-Related Hook Modules

1. **`/bench/repo/web/src/hooks/useMemoShareQueries.ts`** -- Share-link CRUD:
   - `useMemoShares` (query) -- `memoServiceClient.listMemoShares`
   - `useCreateMemoShare` (mutation) -- `memoServiceClient.createMemoShare`
   - `useDeleteMemoShare` (mutation) -- `memoServiceClient.deleteMemoShare`
   - `useSharedMemo` (query) -- `memoServiceClient.getMemoByShare`

2. **`/bench/repo/web/src/components/MemoReactionListView/hooks.ts`** -- Reaction operations (calling `memoServiceClient` directly, not via custom hooks):
   - `memoServiceClient.upsertMemoReaction`
   - `memoServiceClient.deleteMemoReaction`
   - `memoServiceClient.getMemo` (to refresh after reaction toggle)

3. **`/bench/repo/web/src/components/MemoEditor/services/memoService.ts`** -- Editor-level save service:
   - Calls `memoServiceClient.getMemo`, `memoServiceClient.updateMemo`, `memoServiceClient.createMemo`, and `memoServiceClient.createMemoComment` directly
   - Exported as `memoService` (an object, not to be confused with the protobuf `MemoService`)
   - Re-exported from `/bench/repo/web/src/components/MemoEditor/services/index.ts`

4. **`/bench/repo/web/src/components/MemoActionMenu/hooks.ts`** -- Action handlers that consume `useUpdateMemo` and `useDeleteMemo` from `useMemoQueries.ts` for pin/archive/delete operations.

5. **`/bench/repo/web/src/components/MemoView/hooks/useMemoActions.ts`** -- Lightweight hook consuming `useUpdateMemo` (e.g. unpin).

### Full RPC Surface of `MemoService`

The generated protobuf descriptor at `/bench/repo/web/src/types/proto/api/v1/memo_service_pb.ts` defines these RPCs on `MemoService`:

- `createMemo`, `listMemos`, `getMemo`, `updateMemo`, `deleteMemo`
- `setMemoAttachments`, `listMemoAttachments`
- `setMemoRelations`, `listMemoRelations`
- `createMemoComment`, `listMemoComments`
- `listMemoReactions`, `upsertMemoReaction`, `deleteMemoReaction`
- `createMemoShare`, `listMemoShares`, `deleteMemoShare`, `getMemoByShare`
- `getLinkMetadata`, `batchGetLinkMetadata`

### Summary

The primary module is **`/bench/repo/web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts`**, which centralizes memo CRUD mutations (`useCreateMemo`, `useUpdateMemo`, `useDeleteMemo`) and queries (`useMemos`, `useInfiniteMemos`, `useMemo`, `useMemoComments`, `useInfiniteMemoComments`, `useLinkMetadata`). All of these use the **`memoServiceClient`** (defined in `/bench/repo/web/src/connect.ts`), which is a ConnectRPC client wrapping the generated **`MemoService`** protobuf service from `/bench/repo/web/src/types/proto/api/v1/memo_service_pb.ts`. Share-related CRUD is factored into a sibling file at `/bench/repo/web/src/hooks/useMemoShareQueries.ts`.
